title: Calibration failure
sourceDocs: DTP TS tickets via Glean, Sep–Oct 2026

cal_screen.text: What does the calibration result show?
cal_screen.help: Fast failures right after bring-up have been traced to timing (PTP) problems that a cold start cleared (DTP-97082).

options.label: Still running or buffering far too long

cal_sensor.text: What kind of failure is it?

cal_clean.text: Clean the failed sensor, then re-run calibration once
steps: Clean the sensor named in the failure per your sensor-cleaning SOP.
Check nothing is blocking that sensor or the calibration targets.
Re-run calibration from the tool.
cal_clean.caution: Follow SOP for any work outside the cab.

cal_setup.text: Check the setup, clean, and re-run once
steps: Confirm the truck is positioned and driven exactly as the calibration procedure requires.
Confirm the calibration targets are visible and unobstructed.
Clean every sensor listed in the failure.
Re-run calibration.
cal_setup.help: A VRE noted no-target failures usually mean bad data collection: sensors not booted, wrong drive pattern, or blocked sensors or targets.
cal_setup.caution: Follow SOP for any work outside the cab.

cal_stuck.text: Does the tool tell you to get technical support?
cal_stuck.help: In DTP-108061 the stack repeatedly failed to switch to calibration with DEPLOY_FAILED_GET_TECHNICAL_SUPPORT; cold starts and retries didn't fix it.
